data.one_liner: Parses and compares semantic version numbers in compliance with http://semver.org/
data.what_it_does: Provides a Version object to parse, compare, and increment version numbers that follow the Semantic Versioning specification. It handles features like pre-release tags and comparison operators directly in Dart.
use_when: You need to parse semantic version strings in your Dart or Flutter application
You need to compare different application or dependency versions
You want strict adherence to the http://semver.org/ specification
avoid_when: You specifically require the pub_semver package behavior which deviates from the standard semver spec in specific ways
You do not need version parsing or comparison utilities
strengths: Compliant with the Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 specification
Simple and straightforward API with standard comparison operators
weaknesses: Diverts from pub_semver which may be expected in some pub-related tooling
